title: Apex equation for restricted representing data
statement: theorem perfect_hom_open_restricted_limit_pinned {I : Type u} [Preorder I] (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R) {i : I} {Y : Scheme.{u}} (s : Y ⟶ Spec (R.obj i)) [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))] (B : Y.Opens) (a : derivedPullback B.ι ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage B.ι) (Q : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (F : Set.Ici i ⥤ schemeDerivedCategory Y) (d : Cocone F) (h : PerfectHomPushPullData R c s Q F d) (e : PerfectHomOpenRestrictedEquivFields R c s B Q F d) (he : e.limitEquiv ((schemeMVDerivedRestriction Y B).obj d.pt) (𝟙 _) = perfectHomOpenRestrictionMap s B (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)) a (h.limitEquiv d.pt (𝟙 _))) : ∀ (M : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (f : M ⟶ d.pt), e.limitEquiv ((schemeMVDerivedRestriction Y B).obj M) ((schemeMVDerivedRestriction Y B).map f) = perfectHomOpenRestrictionMap s B (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)) a (h.limitEquiv M f)

proof.text: Testing-object naturality expresses the new and original values at f by their values at identity. Apply restriction-map naturality, obtained by expanding the concrete conjugation and comparison naturality, and substitute the supplied identity equation. No equation for arbitrary independently chosen data is asserted.
